variants.title: Haynes-Shockley in p-type silicon: electron drift mobility
variants.method: pulsed laser injection, collector at 3 to 8 mm, 10 to 30 V/cm
variants.unknown: electron drift mobility, diffusion coefficient, lifetime
variants.note: Minority electrons in silicon drift more slowly than holes in germanium and recombine faster, so a stronger field (60 V/cm) keeps the recombination correction to the slope below 0.1 %. Electron mobility 1350 cm^2/V s (Sze) from memory - verify; the lifetime is illustrative.

source.title: Sze and Ng, Physics of Semiconductor Devices: Si electron mobility
